verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Dropbox serves an llms.txt at https://www.dropbox.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. Its visible content is marketing-oriented (cloud storage, Dash, file migration) rather than developer or API guidance, and probes for markdown docs and OpenAPI specs all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers the developer/API documentation, machine-readable markdown versions of the API docs, an OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.dropbox.com/llms.txt # Dropbox
Migrate your files to Dropbox to keep them securely synced across devices.
